profile.headline: Software Engineer II | Full-Stack Web Development
profile.summary:
At Miller Sports + Entertainment, my expertise in web development and AWS services is leveraged to develop high-performing digital solutions. A graduate of Lambda School's Full-Stack Web Development program and holding BSIS and MBA degrees from Strayer University, I bring a unique blend of technical proficiency and business acumen to the table. Our team's commitment to Agile methodologies ensures efficient project delivery and cooperative problem-solving.

With a foundation in Angular 12+, JavaScript/TypeScript, and a rich experience in API integration, I thrive on creating systems that enhance user experience and operational efficiency. The technical guidance I provide supports both colleagues and stakeholders, fostering a collaborative environment where innovation is the norm. My goal is to continue pushing the boundaries of software engineering, delivering robust solutions that drive success.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Proficiency in web development, extensive experience with Angular 12+,  
     JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
• Experience with C# and ASP.NET Core 3.1+.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Proficiency in AWS services including Elastic Beanstalk, Elastic Load Balancer, RDS, EFS, S3, 
   CloudFront, and Lambda.
• Implement and integrate RESTful APIs and ensure efficient client/server communication.
• Collaborate in an Agile team setting, participating actively in SCRUM sessions to deliver high- 
    quality software solutions.
• Design, develop, and manage databases using MySQL and MS SQL.
• Provide technical support and guidance to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring 
    clear and effective communication.

projects.title: Booked Up
projects.description:
An app designed to connect authors with publishing agents. 
HTML | React | Node | CSS 
 - Green field project used to create a platform for private communication between authors and agents
 - Created library functionality using database storage so that authors can upload recent literary works 
 - Built our own API to create a dashboard for authors to filter through authors and their work

projects.title: DevDesk Queue
projects.description:
An app for creating and tracking help desk tickets.
HTML | React | Node | CSS 
 - Simple ticket creation/tracking app used to reinforce the concepts of a full-stack development cycle
 - Created ticket functionality using database storage so that users can submit tickets 
 - Created an API for users to track ticket submissions, status, and completion
